text:
maria: Kicking off a canary for rwd-v3.1-int4-longctx on 10% traffic now. Fast wins on tail latency but seeing signal on longdoc slice — small MRR drop and a bump in citation hallucinations. Posting quick numbers below; want quick triage before promoting. :eyes:

 dmitri: link to dashboards? can you paste the short snapshot?

 maria: dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/dash/rwd-v3.1-int4-longctx/canary
```
baseline   -> p95 latency: 420ms | longdoc_mrr: 0.842 | hallu_rate(citations): 0.9%
canary(10%) -> p95 latency: 360ms | longdoc_mrr: 0.834 | hallu_rate(citations): 2.1%
```

 hao: interesting — latency improvement is great, but hallucination doubling on the citation subtype is concerning. Is the longdoc slice dominated by >3k tokens prompts?

 maria: yes, slice query: longdoc_citations, median ctx ~3500 tokens. Also noticed infer logs show more sampling diversity in tail tokens.

 sarah: could be quantization affecting conditional probabilities on rare tokens in long context. Two quick asks: (1) reduce canary to 2% while we run targeted shadow eval, (2) enable kv-prefix warmup for long contexts to stabilize cached KV distribution.

 dmitri: agree with conservative rollback. Also propose we add an automated fallback rule: if longdoc_mrr_drop >= 0.75% for 10m OR hallucination_rate(citations) >= 1.8% for 5m -> auto-fallback to rwd-v3.0-fp16.

 hao: sample config suggestion (rough):
```yaml
auto_fallback:
  - name: longdoc_mrr_guard
    slice: longdoc_citations
    comparator: drop
    threshold_pct: 0.75
    window: 600
    action: revert_to: rwd-v3.0-fp16
  - name: citation_hallu_guard
    slice: longdoc_citations
    comparator: absolute
    threshold_pct: 1.8
    window: 300
    action: revert_to: rwd-v3.0-fp16
```

 maria: ok doing actions: (1) lowering canary to 2% now, (2) kicking a targeted eval job on the citation slice + rerun with determinism.

 maria: @canary-bot set-canary rwd-v3.1-int4-longctx 2% --note "reduce after hallu spike"

 canary-bot: Canary update: rwd-v3.1-int4-longctx scaled to 2% (requested by maria) — changes applied to routing within 15s. :white_check_mark:

 dmitri: thanks. maria can you also run a shadow-compare for 1% sampled longdocs with top-k=40 deterministic seed and compare token-level divergence? If we see divergence concentrated at citation boundaries it's a red flag for quant setup.

 maria: starting eval: `/eval run --suite citation_longdoc --model rwd-v3.1-int4-longctx --control rwd-v3.0-fp16 --deterministic --topk 40` ETA ~12m

 sarah: add alert in console: rule "longdoc_mrr_drop_watchdog" with severity P1 -> page if triggered. I'll file the temporary oncall note.

 dmitri: for rollback logic we should also check latency budget delta; if latency regressions are neutral or positive we can keep exploring. But if quality regressions persist, auto-fallback config looks good.

 hao: fwiw, on the runtime side I'll enable a conservative `kv_warmup_ratio: 0.5` for longctx routes to reduce cold-KV noise. Will monitor tail CPU/GPU.

 maria: plan: 1) 2% canary live (done), 2) targeted eval running, 3) enable kv-warmup tweak (hao), 4) console alert (sarah), 5) if eval shows token divergence > 1.2% in citation boundaries -> auto-fallback and rollback fully.

 dmitri: sounds good. keep thread updated with eval result and decide next move after 12m. :+1:

 maria: eval finished — preliminary: token divergence concentrated at citation end spans, divergence rate 1.6% vs control, hallucination confirmations in the sample (3 examples). Will post anonymized examples in #eng-ml-priv.

 sarah: paging policy triggered? we haven't hit auto-fallback thresholds yet but divergence >1.2% is in our plan. I recommend we trigger manual rollback to be safe.

 maria: rolling back to rwd-v3.0-fp16 across canary traffic now. @canary-bot revert rwd-v3.1-int4-longctx --to rwd-v3.0-fp16 --note "manual rollback after eval divergence"

 canary-bot: Revert initiated. Canary route removed; traffic restored to rwd-v3.0-fp16 for affected slice. :white_check_mark:

 dmitri: good call. Let's open an onboarding postmortem for quantization specifics on long contexts (owners: maria, hao). Include reproducer, sample traces, and suggested quant tweaks (per-layer thresholds, outlier handling).

 maria: filing retrospective doc and reproducer. I'll also queue a staged re-onboard once we have per-layer quant experiments and shadow 0.5% runs.

 hao: will run per-layer sensitivity sweep next week.

 sarah: closing loop — added the alert and updated runbook to include these auto-fallback thresholds.

 maria: thanks everyone, summary: short-lived 10% canary -> scaled back to 2% -> targeted eval showed divergence -> manual rollback to fp16 -> follow-ups: per-layer quant sweep + staged shadow.

 dmitri: thanks, keep the thread for notes.
